mainEntity.name: What is customer query research for GEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Customer query research for GEO involves analyzing the search terms and questions potential customers use when looking for products or services within specific geographic areas. This research helps businesses understand local demand, optimize their content for location-based searches, and identify opportunities to attract customers in their target regions. It goes beyond general keyword research by focusing on geographical intent.
